نرتشف (form VIII)
# نَرْتَشِفُ (nartašifu) /nar.ta.ʃi.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# نُرْتَشَفُ (nurtašafu) /nur.ta.ʃa.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# نَرْتَشِفَ (nartašifa) /nar.ta.ʃi.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَشَفَ (irtašafa)
# نُرْتَشَفَ (nurtašafa) /nur.ta.ʃa.fa/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
